name: OMV Aktiengesellschaft
via: ÖBAG (Österreichische Beteiligungs AG), the Austrian state holding company, holds 31.5% of OMV; ADNOC (Abu Dhabi) holds 24.9%
note: OMV's own shareholder-structure page: 31.5% ÖBAG, 24.9% ADNOC, ~0.5% treasury/employee shares, 43.1% free float; ÖBAG is 'the Austrian state-owned holding company managing the investments of the Republic of Austria'. ÖBAG and ADNOC have a consortium agreement providing for coordinated behaviour. Majority owner (51.2%) of OMV Petrom.
